rationale: Retain the pinned Var getter, symbol, metadata, Object/toString, dereference and all twenty-two IFn invocation signatures. Native compiler-generated getters read actual persistent binding cells and compiler-owned cells intern one Var per canonical phase binding. Adapt identity/equality/hash, mutable declaration metadata and macro metadata to Clojure Var semantics; omit the ClojureScript Fn marker and IWithMeta copying because a Clojure Var is an identity-bearing reference, not a function or metadata-copying value. Primary/native controls remain separate acceptance evidence. Real root-cell macro flags clear on every root bind, including restoration; public metadata and isMacro consult that flag rather than retaining stale declaration status.
